product_metadata.title: Excellante Ham Holder, Chrome Plated, 8-1/2 by 7-1/4 by 6-Inch
features: Plated with chrome for silvery color and durability
Chrome ham holder is ideal for any restaurant, buffet, catering, parties, or other event where carved meats, especially ham, are served
Easy to wash with mild detergent and damp cloth.
Sturdy rack will grip a ham of any size nicely, while roasting or while being sliced
Great way to hold a ham in place while also saving space
description: Excellante ham holder - chrome plated 8-1/2 x 7-1/4 by 6-inch . This is a chrome plated wire ham holder. The chrome plated wire ham holder is essential for any venue that serves carved meats. This holds a large ham perfectly within its wire frame ready to be cut and served
